name: codex-claude-desktop-bridge
description: Send native messages between Codex Desktop tasks and Claude Desktop Code sessions on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Message Codex and Claude Desktop conversations.
interface.longDescription: Find local conversations and send text between Codex Desktop tasks and Claude Desktop Code sessions on Windows. Either application can start a conversation or reply.
defaultPrompt: Open the Claude conversation panel beside this Codex chat so I can search chats, read history, and send a message manually.
Find the Claude Desktop Code conversation I name and send it my message.
Check the bridge status and recent outgoing deliveries.
